title: Palimpsest Intelligence Commons
scope: A public, provenance-bearing map of China information controls, monetary plumbing, illicit-market observables, and reviewed laundering or scam signals across four independently governed projects.
claim_boundary: The lanes are descriptive context, not a fused score or causal model. Temporal alignment or co-movement does not establish that drug proceeds, scams, censorship, underground banking, or any person or entity caused money-market stress, and no typology relationship establishes guilt.

projects.title: Palimpsest
projects.role: Public OSINT index, evidence protocol, provenance ledger, and human-review publication boundary.
projects.public_boundary: Publishes public-source measurements and privacy-minimized reviewed aggregates; stale or absent collection remains visible and is never converted to a zero.

projects.title: Seiche
projects.role: Public money-market plumbing and funding-stress context with sealed market APIs.
projects.public_boundary: Provides observed or derived monetary context under its own evidence and redistribution gates; intelligence-commons signals remain context-only and do not enter composites, forecasts, or trading eligibility.

projects.title: ScamShield
projects.role: Consent-scoped and operator-authorized scam or suspicious-payment assessment with reviewed aggregate export.
projects.public_boundary: Coverage is limited to submitted and configured authorized surfaces; public interchange excludes raw messages, exact indicators, private assessments, and unreviewed monetary sums.

projects.title: NarcoScope
projects.role: Public aggregate drug-market observatory with a deterministic official-source China handoff and declared coverage gaps.
projects.public_boundary: Only aggregate, licence-compatible observations cross the boundary. The live object contains official China dataset envelopes and excludes subject names, aliases, exact addresses, identifiers, private leads, and illustrative inputs.

lanes.title: Information controls
lanes.question: What is being deleted, blocked, suppressed, rerouted, or made harder to observe in and around China?
lanes.evidence_rule: Show source, native cadence, event and knowledge time, freshness, coverage, method, and limitations; collection failure or silence is not evidence of calm.

lanes.title: Monetary plumbing
lanes.question: What do observable CNY funding, fixing, cross-border, and market-plumbing measures say without importing illicit-flow assumptions?
lanes.evidence_rule: Preserve instrument, units, jurisdiction, event time, source licence, revision state, and Seiche eligibility; intelligence-commons context never enters a composite or forecast by default.

lanes.title: Illicit-market observables
lanes.question: What do China's official aggregate prices, seizures, precursor incidents, designation coverage, and wildlife-confiscation coverage show, and where is the record too sparse to answer?
lanes.evidence_rule: Publish aggregate observations at their native jurisdiction and cadence with exact substance flags, source hashes, intervals where required, and no person-level edges or extrapolation from missing modalities.

lanes.title: Reviewed laundering and scam signals
lanes.question: What bounded patterns and reviewed monetary events appear in ScamShield's authorized sampling frame?
lanes.evidence_rule: Publish only privacy-minimized aggregates that pass coverage, source-dominance, review, redistribution, and support-level gates; a message pattern does not establish proceeds, origin, or guilt.

connections.claim_boundary: The pack supplies inert reviewed source and typology definitions, not executable detection rules, case evidence, or attribution.
The active local bridge produces private capsules and human-review candidates only; it does not auto-publish raw messages, exact indicators, owner-only values, or message-only attribution.
Palimpsest readings are external context with their own freshness and provenance; they do not become independent corroboration when a mirror shares the same upstream pipeline.
A future public projection may show eligible observed market context, but no illicit-market lane becomes a Seiche model input and no cross-lane co-movement is a causal claim.

The live deterministic object contains five official, aggregate China dataset envelopes with provenance and limitations. The values do not establish a person-level link, market total, illicit source of funds, or causal relationship.

private_boundary: Private owner-operated analysis may consume admitted public envelopes inward, but it is not a project in this public manifest, a dependency of any public project, or a source of public calibrated outputs. No private repository, filesystem path, implementation detail, code, data, parameter, or calibration crosses outward.
limitations: The four projects have different sampling frames, jurisdictions, licences, revision policies, and cadences; records must not be silently joined or forward-filled.
The commons does not claim to show everything happening in China, all of Telegram, the total illicit economy, or unobserved financial flows.
Primary endpoints, archives, and mirrors that share one upstream collection pipeline count as one source group.
ScamShield reviewed events are bounded samples and must not be extrapolated into national proceeds or total platform activity.
NarcoScope-to-Palimpsest is active, producer-owned, and byte-pinned in Palimpsest; Seiche-to-Palimpsest remains a planned envelope projection.
Licence-restricted or privacy-controlled values remain redacted even when their source and coverage state are visible.

Cross-lane lag analysis requires a preregistered hypothesis, native-cadence alignment, an untouched holdout, independent sources, and publication of null results before any narrower association claim.
